acceptance_criteria.description: The focused remediation suite passes with all managed-launch environment, runtime, custody, lease, and artifact-store checks green.
The project build passes without changing the working tree.
The clean real-Tinto stdio probe reaches READY, returns bounded surface and snapshot evidence, and the first close returns idle.
No files change during this validation unit and no out-of-scope command or mutation occurs.

closed_decisions: Root aggregate verification passed 124 focused tests with 2 skips, pnpm build, and the real-Tinto stdio probe with READY and first close idle.
Prior worker terminals failed strict evaluation; their code is preserved but their self-reported readiness evidence is not counted.

Do not run commands outside the declared read-only and verification commands.
